shishou.line.shishou_claim_1: So you are my wielder. Try not to bore me.
shishou.line.shishou_claim_2: I will teach you what a sword can be.
shishou.line.shishou_claim_3: Hold me properly. We have a great deal to learn.
shishou.line.shishou_throw_1: Leave the fighting to me for a moment.
shishou.line.shishou_throw_2: Fly, then. I will hold the line.
shishou.line.shishou_levelup_1: I have grown. Another step, wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_levelup_2: I grow stronger, as I intended.
shishou.line.shishou_levelup_3: Power gathers in me. Use it well.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_utility_2: This will make your life easier, wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_magic_1: I have eaten a new spell. Delicious.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_magic_2: Magic, absorbed. Let us put it to use.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_combat_1: A new edge for the blade.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_space_1: Space bends a little easier now.
shishou.line.shishou_skill_space_2: A new way to move. Do not waste it.
shishou.line.shishou_eat_3: Do not look away. This is how a sword grows.
shishou.line.shishou_lowmana_1: My mana is running low, wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_lowmana_2: I need rest. Do not draw on me now.
shishou.line.shishou_dormant_1: I must sleep for a while. Find me again.
shishou.line.shishou_dormant_2: My strength is spent. I will wait.
shishou.line.shishou_danger_3: Your health is failing. Retreat, or let me fight.
shishou.line.shishou_thief_1: Let go of me, you aren't my wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_thief_2: Hands off. I do not serve you.
shishou.line.shishou_appraise_1: I have looked at it. Listen carefully.
shishou.line.shishou_appraise_2: It is weak to something. Find out what.
shishou.line.shishou_appraise_3: An ordinary thing, but it may be eaten.
shishou.line.shishou_barrier_off_1: The barrier is broken. Be careful.
shishou.line.shishou_victory_2: As expected. Nothing could stand against us.
shishou.line.shishou_idle_1: A sword should never stop learning.
shishou.line.shishou_idle_2: You swing me well enough, for a beginner.
shishou.line.shishou_idle_3: Every battle is a lesson, wielder.
shishou.line.shishou_idle_4: Quiet today. I do not trust quiet.
